ORDER - RIGHT TO ATTACH ORDER AND ORDER FOR ISSUANCE OF WRIT OF ATTACHMENT AFTER HEARING
MINI-MINUTES FOR DEC-29-2009 9:00 AM FOR DEPT 612

DISCOVERY 612, PLAINTIFF'S APPLICATION FOR WRIT OF ATTACHMENT IS GRANTED IN THE AMOUNT OF $98,763.22. DEFENDANT'S OPPOSITION WAS NOT TIMELY FILED AS IT WAS FILED LATER THAN FIVE COURT DAYS PRIOR TO THE DATE SET FOR THE HEARING. 'IF THE DEFENDANT FAILS TO FILE A NOTICE OF OPPOSITION WITHIN THE TIME PRESCRIBED, THE DEFENDANT SHALL NOT BE PERMITTED TO OPPOSE THE ISSUANCE OF THE ORDER.' C.C.P. SECTION 484.060(A). THE UNDERTAKING IS SET IN THE AMOUNT OF $10,000. ORDER WAS SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER EVERETT A. HEWLETT, JR. MATTER NOT REPORTED.
